text:
deploybot: Automated release hold triggered: Canary slot eu-7 saw error-rate spike to 4.3% at 01:07 UTC. Holding all 01:00 UTC releases. Reason: repeated 5xx from kvcache layer after kernel swap. Logs: ```kvcache eviction=high kernel=opt-A status=503 trace=abc123```
ira_ops: Confirmed incident, we're in mitigation. Recommend freeze + pin current production version before further rollouts. :warning:
alex_m: Should we roll back canary or abort the rest and cherrypick a hotfix? What's impact surface? I'm worried about embeddings jobs.
maria_g: My vote: abort rollout, pin prod to v2026-03-18-rc5, cherrypick the kvcache guard and push to staging for smoke. If smoke passes, canary-only retry with smaller batch size.
samir: Ok. I'll draft release note update + customer-facing blurb for any delayed deployments. Who's on docs to update the changelog?
calvin: @oncall_ops - can you own coordinating the new window? Prefer to move to 02:00 UTC with SRE shadow and DB oncall standing by.
jen: I'll take release notes + changelog. Also adding rollback and hotfix commands to the thread for ops: ```# rollback canary
/ops rollback --service=inference --slot=eu-7 --to-version=v2026-03-18-rc5
# pin prod
/ops pin --service=inference --version=v2026-03-18-rc5 --reason="kvcache spike"
# cherrypick
/gerrit cherry-pick 12345 --branch=rc5``` 
deploybot: Hold acknowledged. Scheduling blocked for window 01:00-03:00 UTC. Canary retries disabled. Reschedule candidates: 1717819200 (02:00 UTC) and 1717822800 (03:00 UTC). Use `/deploybot resume <ts>` when ready.
ira_ops: Add follow-up: run the smoke suite: `smoke --suite=canary-smoke --region=eu --timeout=10m`. If failure rate <0.5% for 15m, proceed to a phased roll (10% -> 50% -> 100%).
alex_m: I'll prepare the cherrypick PR and tag ops for the rollout checklist. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
samir: Noted; customers on the load-testing cohort will be flagged. I'll ping CS for heads-up.
calvin: Ops will confirm new window in 15m. If not, default is delay to 04:00 UTC. Keep this thread as single source of truth.
jen: Done — changelog updated and release note draft in google.doc: https://docs.internal/release-notes/rl-1717801234
ira_ops: Closing loop: pin applied, canary rolled back, hold in place. Will post a postmortem link once post-incident analysis done.
